comparison_semantics: meaning_code equals explicit comparison_target; SET_COMPARISON_FOCUS:<direction> or UNKNOWN/NO_CHANGE; direction set must exist in independently prepared comparison binding specification; no score effect
non_scoring_numeric_policy: numeric values may describe confidence, burden, style or support; only rules.score_roles enter recommendation scoring; numeric presence is not scoring authorization
